def main():
    import sys
    input = sys.stdin.read
    data = input().split()
    
    n = int(data[0])
    m = int(data[1])
    
    s = data[2:2+n]
    t = data[2+n:2+n+m]
    
    q = int(data[2+n+m])
    queries = [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(q)]
    
    for y in queries:
        year_name = concat(s, t, y)
        print(year_name)

def concat(s, t, y):
    s_index = (y - 1) % len(s)
    t_index = (y - 1) % len(t)
    return s[s_index] + t[t_index]

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
